data.body: Correction to the description (2026-11-09 15:20 PST): the harness does NOT exit on this error. The 12:21 PST run (pid 27240) printed the 'cannot list .tickets-tracker' line and kept running, making model calls for 3 hours. The error is a non-fatal line on stderr, so the observed defect is a misleading error message emitted before the run proceeds, not an aborted run. Which call emits it is still untraced. The reproduction steps showing a second run proceeding after a CLI call are unaffected; the claim that the first run stopped was wrong.
